page.title: File -> Open
page.introduction: This section describes the File->Open menu option. The Open menu option allows the user to open an existing VCell document - BioModel, MathModel or Geometry - from the user's account or a model shared by other users.

operations.para: Clicking on File->Open menu option displays a dialog for opening a BioModel..., MathModel... or Geometry... document. The dialog lists the documents of that type you can open, the way the Welcome window does: a search field, your Recent ones, and the VCell Database lists (Community, Personal and Tutorial). Double-click a document, or select it and press Open or Enter. For example, clicking on 'File->Open->BioModel' will open a dialog that lists all BioModels accessible to current user. The same dialog is used wherever VCell asks you to choose a saved document: comparing with another model, creating a MathModel from a BioModel application, choosing a geometry from the database or from another model's applications, and in the Testing Framework. Additionally, Local... displays a local file chooser to select VCell documents saved on the user's own computer (using 'File->Export / Save to File...').
